subject: learning/ci-parity-enforcement
statement: A shared runner mirrors only its registered checks; CI parity also requires rejecting every independent blocking workflow step.
intent: Keep local pre-push, executor verification, and hosted checks on the same complete predicate.
rationale: The memory debt ratchet was added as a separate GitHub workflow after the code gate was centralized. CI parity now parses the complete workflow directory, rejects unregistered or conditional blocking checks, pins event-supplied bases, and permits only bounded runner setup or explicit advisory and release jobs. The memory-gate command composes existing record integrity and reconciliation predicates, while named code-gate selection reuses their canonical commands. Cached verdicts include Git history refs and environment values.
fit_criterion: Workflow mutation regressions reject added remote-only jobs, hidden shell commands, missing gates, and substituted bases; memory-gate regressions reject record rewrites and widened allowances; same-tree history and environment changes invalidate cached verdicts.
learned_from: The operator reported a fourth local versus hosted CI divergence; TestRepositoryCoverageGateWiring passed while the memory workflow was missing locally. The new regressions in internal/ciparity and internal/memory/cli exercise those failures.
